svg.title: Heart rate on a hill: fakemy.run vs Runsketch
svg.desc: Line chart of a 28-minute, 5 km run with one hill. fakemy.run's heart rate is a noisy hump that peaks at half-time on flat ground and falls during the climb. Runsketch's heart-rate demand rises on the climb and drops at the crest, and its recorded heart rate follows with a lag, taking about 80 seconds after the crest to settle to demand.
